propositions: Plan-review coaching currently renders fixes per finding, so when multiple findings share one root cause (incomplete population enumeration), the author receives N instance-level fixes rather than signal that the enumeration method is fundamentally wrong.

A single enumeration-method failure resulted in one story requiring 7 review passes and ~35 blocking findings across multiple distinct criteria, because the author kept adding specific named instances instead of enumerating the complete population.

Existing move 12 (generalize) cannot verify completeness; three passes claimed the enumeration was complete when it was not, only ending when an acceptance criterion with a grep-based check exposed remaining unenumerated members.

A new built-in move 15 'sample, not the population' must reframe named instances as population samples and require machine-checkable completeness proofs, scoped to criteria where populations actually exist (G1G2, E4, G6, A1).

Move 15 must be added to MOVE_REGISTRY with exact id, name, template, and applies_when declarations, mirrored in the docs move table, and covered by focused unit tests without modifying any existing move or core review kernel.
